anlageV.metaTitle: Anlage V for landlords who live outside Germany
anlageV.metaDescription: Who has to file Germany's Anlage V from abroad, which forms belong to it and when it is due. A guided calculator is in preparation.
anlageV.title: Anlage V: German rental income for owners who live abroad
anlageV.lead: If you rent out property in Germany without living there, the rent is still taxed in Germany. You declare it once a year on Anlage V.

facts.label: Who files
facts.value: Anyone who rents out property in Germany without a home there. Germany calls this limited tax liability.

facts.label: Forms
facts.value: The main form ESt 1 C plus one Anlage V for each property, filed online through ELSTER.

facts.label: What is taxed
facts.value: Rent received minus deductible costs, such as depreciation of the building, loan interest, management and repairs.

facts.label: Deadline
facts.value: 31 July of the following year if you file yourself.
